name: Canvas
summary: Courses, assignments and grades on your phone
description: See assignments in a weekly view, check grades and discussions, and revisit cached coursework offline. Import your own Canvas setup file.
author: thooton

changes.text: Typing is saved at once when the app goes to the background or the editor closes within the autosave's pause, not dropped.
A command center that can't say its Canvas no longer stops the sync; nothing for a signed-out account is saved after sign-out; late results after the app starts over are dropped.
Common: setup files written whole from any thread, leftover setup files cleaned up, and every app on common bumped.
Set up from a setup file (an access token, a cookie service, or a command center's relay); no login built in.
Build and publish immutable Wave package releases alongside the legacy channel.
Turn Android backup on in every app, so adb backup can move their data to another phone.
Launch waits behind a loading bar for the real state, and syncs faster.
Read back a typed answer or link after turning it in.
A failed turn-in no longer leaves 'Turning in…' on the page, and the other fixes.
Shorter 12-hour reminder times so Reminders fits at Large.
